en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small wooden bridge with diagonal railings in a landscaped park. The path continues beyond the bridge, lined with trees and bushes, and leads uphill towards a large multi‑storey building partly visible among the trees. There is a lamppost on the right side of the path. The lower border bears captions in Bulgarian and French identifying the location.
